name: Yagi Sekka
source:
Although an Imperial citizen, she serves in the Republican Army under circumstances that remain entirely unknown. Often seen accompanying her superior officer, Rochelle, she appears to operate within a separate chain of command from regular soldiers. She is frequently observed entering and leaving Republican Army facilities, yet her true identity, role, and ultimate purpose remain shrouded in mystery.
[spoiler]
Favorite: Cocoa mint cookies
Because she had committed acts of treachery against the Empire, it was believed that she could not escape a death sentence, and she had once resigned herself to dying. However, she was spared following the war through Kotone’s earnest petition.
She was appointed caretaker of the shrine dedicated to Kuroshu Ōkami, built in a quiet corner of the Imperial Sanctuary, and has since lived a life of peace.
Yet, believing it a waste to leave her unused talents, she was eventually summoned to participate in a certain national project.[/spoiler]
